bwGuide.changeBody: Press Edit slots, click any slot in the preview and pick a field. Set a slot to (empty) and its neighbour grows into the free row, so a trimmed layout gets bigger numbers rather than gaps. Apply writes it to the card.
bwGuide.installBody: Power the radio, connect USB, choose USB Storage (SD) on its screen, then press Install here. ArduDeck copies the script and points every model's telemetry screen at it, so there is nothing to set up on the radio.
bwGuide.listenBody: The callouts play whether or not the telemetry screen is open, so you can watch the aircraft: telemetry gained and lost, battery thresholds, fence and EKF warnings. Arming calls stay silent until the vehicle actually reports armed state, rather than guessing.
bwGuide.openBody: Eject the card, unplug USB, then press PAGE from the main view until the ArduDeck screen appears. It sits with the radio's other telemetry screens.
bwGuide.pressPageHint: press PAGE from the main view
bwGuide.readBody: Top strip: flight mode, armed timer, link quality. Bottom strip: the vehicle's own messages. Between them, everything is a slot: the big readout, a left column, the horizon (or two more data columns) and a right column. An S before the signal figure means the values come from EdgeTX's own sensors rather than passthrough.
bwGuide.title: The HUD on a monochrome radio

bwPreview.editingHint: Click any slot to pick what it shows; set one to (empty) and its neighbour grows into the space.
bwPreview.flipPagesTip: Click to flip pages (rotary / +/- on the radio)
bwPreview.pageHint: Page {{page}}/2, click to flip (rotary or +/- on the radio). Everything between the status strips is an editable slot: the big readout, both side columns, and the center panel (horizon or two more data columns).

radioHudView.addPageTip: Add a layout page (swipe left/right on the radio to switch)
radioHudView.appliedAll: Applied to every model on this radio. Eject before unplugging.
radioHudView.appliedBw: Applied. Telemetry screen set on {{count}} model(s) - eject, unplug, press PAGE on the radio.
radioHudView.appliedModel: Applied to the model "{{model}}" only. Eject before unplugging the radio.
radioHudView.applyTip: Install/refresh the widget and write this layout to the SD card. Afterwards on the radio: App layout, full-screen widget, ArduDeck
radioHudView.deleteTip: Delete "{{name}}" from ArduDeck. Whatever is already on the radio stays there.
radioHudView.demoTip: The radio animates a scripted flight with voice callouts when nothing is connected, badged DEMO. Also toggled by tapping the NO LINK screen
radioHudView.detectedSwitchTip: The plugged-in radio identifies itself in RADIO/radio.yml - apply to the wrong screen class and it installs files the radio cannot use
radioHudView.dragHint: Drag to move, corner handle to resize (8px snap). Top bar and message ticker are fixed.
radioHudView.ejectNeedsRestart: Eject needs an app restart to activate (new capability)
radioHudView.ejectTip: Safely eject the SD volume so the radio can leave USB storage mode
radioHudView.ejected: Ejected. Unplug the radio; the widget reloads its config within seconds.
radioHudView.everyModelUses: - every model uses this layout unless it has its own
radioHudView.fieldMapsTip: Offline satellite images for the Map tile. Click your field; the rings show each zoom's coverage
radioHudView.guideTip: How the HUD works on a monochrome radio: installing, opening it, reading it
radioHudView.inputDebug: Show input debug on the radio
radioHudView.inputDebugTip: Prints what the radio hands the widget: fullscreen yes/no, the last key event value, the last touch, and which page is showing. For working out why a button does nothing.
radioHudView.layoutForTip: Which layout Apply writes and Load reads. Models share one layout unless you give a model its own; the radio then uses that one whenever the model is selected.
radioHudView.layoutsTip: Layouts live in ArduDeck and save as you edit. The radio only gets the one you apply.
radioHudView.loadFromRadioTip: Read the config and tile layout currently on the SD card into the editor
radioHudView.loadFromVehicleTip: Fill the fields from the connected vehicle's parameters
radioHudView.loadedFromCache: Loaded from cached parameters (vehicle not currently connected)
radioHudView.loadedOwnLayout: Loaded the layout "{{model}}" has of its own.
radioHudView.loadedShared: Loaded the shared layout every model uses.
radioHudView.lookingForRadioHint: Looking for a radio. Plug in via USB and choose USB Storage (SD) on its screen; it takes a few seconds to appear.
radioHudView.mapsNeedCenter: Set a field center first (connect the vehicle or type coordinates)
radioHudView.mapsReady: Ready: {{zooms}} zoom levels, ships with next Apply
radioHudView.mapsReadyMissing: Ready ({{zooms}} zooms), {{missing}} tiles missing - browse this area on the app map once to cache them, then regenerate
radioHudView.newLayoutTip: Start a new layout in ArduDeck. The current one is already saved.
radioHudView.noConfigOnCard: No ArduDeck config found on the card
radioHudView.noOwnLayout: "{{model}}" has no layout of its own yet, so this is the shared one.
radioHudView.noRadioFound: No radio found. Plug in the transmitter via USB and choose "USB Storage (SD)" on its screen, then apply again.
radioHudView.noRadioYet: No radio yet. On the radio choose USB Storage (SD); still looking.
radioHudView.noVehicleData: No vehicle data yet - connect the vehicle once so its parameters can be read
radioHudView.onlyModelUses: - only "{{model}}" uses this layout, the rest keep the shared one
radioHudView.pageTip: Page {{n}} - swipe on the radio to reach it
radioHudView.previewTip: Faithful mirror of layout and colors at the selected radio's resolution; the radio renders its own font
radioHudView.radioModelTip: Radio model - layouts rescale to its screen
radioHudView.removeTip: Delete the ArduDeck widget and its config from the SD card (only files we installed)
radioHudView.renameTip: Renames this layout. Saving is automatic.
radioHudView.resetTip: Put every slot back to the default layout
radioHudView.subtitle: ArduDeck widget for EdgeTX radios
radioHudView.title: Radio HUD
radioHudView.turnPagesTip: In a normal widget slot EdgeTX gives the widget no keys and no touch, so this is the only way to see every page there. Long-press the widget and choose Full screen to use PAGE and swipe instead.
radioHudView.useVehiclePositionTip: Center the field on where the vehicle is right now
radioHudView.widgetConfigTip: Everything here is an override. Left on auto, the widget configures itself from the vehicle's telemetry - no ArduDeck or FC connection needed
radioHudView.widgetRemoved: Widget removed from the radio (config included).
radioHudView.widgetWillInstall: - widget will be installed on apply
